title: Unisex Muay Thai – My Shins Have Seen Things. Hoodie

seo.title: Muay Thai Hoodie – My Shins Have Seen Things.
seo.description: A funny muay thai hoodie for fighters: MY SHINS HAVE SEEN THINGS. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

MY SHINS HAVE SEEN THINGS. is the muay thai hoodie for the fighter whose lower legs have taken more than anyone knows, worn in the gym, on the walk home from training and as a gift from a partner who has kicked them.

MY SHINS runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and HAVE SEEN THINGS. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a worn-out fighter in plain navy boxing shorts and loose red hand wraps sits on a cream gym bench with a flat thousand-yard stare, a bag of frozen peas in his hands and one bruised shin on show.

Navy carries cream and faded red lettering with a cream edge around the bench; Sand gets navy and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this muay thai hoodie warm enough for cold gym mornings and long training days?
Yes. The My Shins Have Seen Things. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold gym mornings, long training days and ice-pack evenings.

How does the My Shins Have Seen Things. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a muay thai fighter?
It is a natural one. Every nak muay knows the ache of a bruised shin, so it lands with training partners, coaches and the friends who hand over the frozen peas. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the bench scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the My Shins Have Seen Things. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
